name: Écureuil v3
description:
Le terme écureuil est un nom vernaculaire ambigu qui désigne en français de nombreuses espèces de rongeurs grimpeurs de taille moyenne, parfois même « volants ». Leur queue, plus ou moins touffue selon les espèces, forme un panache ou un plumeau caractéristique. Ils appartiennent presque tous à la famille des Sciuridés, qui comprend aussi les chiens de prairies et les marmottes, mais quelques écureuils volants font partie de la famille des Anomaluridés.

La queue en panache de l’écureuil et son acharnement à faire des provisions pour l’hiver ont contribué à sa popularité et en ont fait un animal emblématique souvent présent dans la symbolique et la culture.

name: MUNDO POSIBLE CON BIOARQUITECTURA 2
description:
Modelos elaborados en el marco del trabajo de grado ***“Mundos plausibles y bioarquitecturas: Modelos de simulación para la coevolución entre sistemas ecológicos habitables”***, desarrollado como requisito para optar al título de Arquitecta en la Pontificia Universidad Javeriana, Facultad de Arquitectura y Diseño.

Estas bioarquitecturas fueron construidas en el entorno del *videojuego Minecraft y exportadas mediante la herramienta Mineways*, como parte de una metodología de simulación computacional orientada a explorar configuraciones espaciales adaptativas, ecosistémicamente sensibles y plausibles desde una perspectiva biocéntrica. Los modelos se utilizaron en procesos de simulación bioarquitectónica aplicados a mundos posibles, y forman parte del componente experimental de la investigación. Para conocer en profundidad la propuesta y su desarrollo, la tesis completa se encuentra disponible en el repositorio de la universidad.

name: Freshwater Moray Eel
description:
Gymnothorax polyuranodon was named by Pieter Bleeker in 1853.
The species can reach a maximum length of 1.5 metres (4.9 feet), but it is rarely seen larger than 1 metre (3 feet). Its colouration is yellow or light tan, covered with dark brown spots and blotches. The freshwater moray has very small teeth in proportion to the size of its head, and, like all moray eels, is carnivorous. Its diet consists almost entirely of fish, and occasionally shrimp, bivalves, and worms, and it prefers to eat live food. Like many moray eels, it has poor vision but an excellent sense of smell, and it can be aggressive. The species' saliva is slightly toxic. While not lethal, a bite can nevertheless be very painful, and the injury may result in infection.

description: Spinosaurus is a genus of large spinosaurid theropod dinosaurs that lived in what now is North Africa during the Cenomanian stage of the Late Cretaceous period, about 100 to 94 million years ago. The genus was known first from Egyptian remains discovered in 1912 and described by German palaeontologist Ernst Stromer in 1915. The original remains were destroyed in World War II, but additional material came to light in the early 21st century. It is unclear whether one or two species are represented in the fossils reported in the scientific literature. The type species S. aegyptiacus is mainly known from Egypt and Morocco. Although a potential second species, S. maroccanus, has been recovered from Morocco, this dubious species is likely a junior synonym of S. aegyptiacus.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spinosaurus

name: Black Myth: Wukong - Liu Mei [Static]
description:
Liu Mei - Introduction

Liu Mei is the youngest child in the family. She usually lives with her sisters. The sisters are very gentle to her, except for the Si Jie (see my render), who will strictly supervise the Liu Mei to practice martial arts. Si Jie sometimes takes the Liu Mei to the top of the mountain and tells her stories outside the mountain. Once a flower viewing banquet was held in the mountains. When the Liu Mei was playing alone, she met two drunken pig demons. They laughed at the Liu Mei and hinted that her father was also a pig demon. They wanted to see the little girl angry. As a result, the Liu Mei didn't care. She refuted that the pig demon wanted to make relatives because of his low level of Taoism. The person that her mother liked must not be a dirty thing like a pig demon.

name: Wolf - Animated
description: The wolf (Canis lupus;[b] pl.: wolves), also known as the gray wolf or grey wolf, is a large canine native to Eurasia and North America. More than thirty subspecies of Canis lupus have been recognized, including the dog and dingo, though gray wolves, as popularly understood, only comprise naturally-occurring wild subspecies. The wolf is the largest extant member of the family Canidae, and is further distinguished from other Canis species by its less pointed ears and muzzle, as well as a shorter torso and a longer tail. The wolf is nonetheless related closely enough to smaller Canis species, such as the coyote and the golden jackal, to produce fertile hybrids with them. The wolf's fur is usually mottled white, brown, gray, and black, although subspecies in the arctic region may be nearly all white.

name: Funny Weapons (low poly)
description:
This is a low poly set of funny weapons.

Stump Thumper:
Carved from a single tree trunk and swung with primal force. It’s not elegant, but neither is getting flattened by half a forest.

The Banana Blade:
An overripe banana turned blade, its peel acts like a natural crossguard while the curved fruit delivers shockingly firm slashes.

The Hot Dog Hacker:
A perfectly grilled hot dog jammed into sturdy buns more weapon than wiener. The mustard trails like battle scars, and every swing hits with meaty resolve. Beware of ketchup enhanced crits.

The Baguette Basher:
Crisp on the outside, devastating on the inside. This hardened baguette has seen more battles than bakeries. 

The Pike Pike:
A long, streamlined fish repurposed into a deadly lance. Its armored scales glint like steel,and its rigid body pierces with unsettling precision.

The Frying Pan Flail:
This iron pan packs more than a punch, it is breakfast and a beating in one. With a scorched egg lying on its surface, each swing lands with crispy fury.

name: An Autumn Stroll 🍁
description:
What can be better than a nice stroll during the wonderful vibes of autumn. A father and a son having a bonding moment during one of the most beautiful seasons of the year. This was supposed to be finished last year, but it was delayed due to a busy schedule. 

I'm happy to work on this piece, and I apologize for taking to long on this. If you saw my last post, I decided to keep using Sketchfab and start posting smaller project here. Projects that will help me practice and get good in what I'm doing. Thanks for checking my works over the years! God bless you all and I hope to see you all in the future. 

If I do post, it will mostly be on my Artstation to improve my portfolio, so give it a follow ;) https://www.artstation.com/mortyjhin

name: Hedgehog figurine
description:
A hedgehog is a small, nocturnal mammal known for its distinctive coat of stiff, sharp spines. These spines act as a defense mechanism—when threatened, a hedgehog curls into a tight ball, making it difficult for predators to attack. Hedgehogs are found in Europe, Asia, and Africa, and they thrive in various environments, including forests, grasslands, and gardens.
They have excellent hearing and smell, which helps them locate insects, worms, and other small creatures to eat. Hedgehogs are solitary animals and typically only interact with others during mating season. They are also known for their adorable, snuffling noises and their ability to roam great distances at night.
Some people keep hedgehogs as pets, but they require specific care, including a proper diet, a warm environment, and enough space to explore. Despite their prickly appearance, they can be quite friendly and curious!

X-ray computed tomography was performed at the Diamond Light Source beamline I12-JEEP (90 keV beam, 18.53 µm pixel size) as part of experimental session MG33954-1. name: Морска лястовица (Trigla Lucerna Linne)
description:
Морска лястовица е вид риба от семейство Морски лястовици. Обитава крайбрежни води на дълбочина 10 - 60 м.
Една от най-красивите черноморски риби, с оцветено в червеникаво тяло и бяло коремче. Гръдните и плавници са пурпурни, с черно петно и ярко сини краища. Много добри плувци, но също могат да прелитат известно разстояние над водата, откъдето са получили името си. Издава звуци, подобни на грухтене или бърборене, които служат за да събират пасажите от млади риби заедно.

description:
**The Dark Lord and His Captive Dancer**
Baz Baz Qandi, the dark and twisted demon lord, controls the fate of the helpless Haji Firuz.

Every Nowruz, Haji Firuz, the beloved Persian symbol of joy and new beginnings, is forced to dance through the streets. Bound by chains, he dances to entertain his cruel master, Baz Baz Qandi.

name: Coeloria lamellina (NHMW-ZOO-EV-0015176)
description:
3D scan of the calcium carbonate skeleton of a stony coral (*Coeloria lamellina*). This coral was collected during the Austro-Hungarian deep-sea expeditions of 1890–1898. Onboard of the SMS Pola scientists conducted the first comprehensive oceanographic and biological studies of the Mediterranean and Red Seas. 

This specimen is currently not on display. 

**Species**: *Coeloria lamellina* Ehrenberg, 1834

**Inventory number**: NHMW-ZOO-EV-0015176

**Origin**: Pola expedition, Jeddah, Red Sea

**Collection**: Natural History Museum Vienna, 3rd Zoological Dept., Evertebrata varia Coll. (curator: Pedro R. Frade)

Find out more about the NHMW [here](http://www.nhm.at/en).

Scanned & edited by M. Preslmayr and A. Haider (NHMW)

Scanner: Artec Space Spider

Contribution to the digitization project „Einsichten in die gesellschaftspolitische Dimension des NHMW über die Jahrhunderte von der Prägung des Wissenschafts-Verständnisses bis zum Nationalpark in der Lobau“ funded by the [BMWKMS](https://bmwkms.gv.at/).

name: Lepus europaeus #16121
description:
The European hare (Lepus europaeus), also known as the brown hare, is a species of hare native to Europe and parts of Asia. It is among the largest hare species and is adapted to temperate, open country. Hares are herbivorous and feed mainly on grasses and herbs, supplementing these with twigs, buds, bark and field crops, particularly in winter. Their natural predators include red foxes and large birds of prey. They rely on high-speed endurance running to escape predation, having long, powerful limbs and large nostrils.

This model was realized by Glenda Cantale during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at the Genoa University.

name: Passauer Wolf
description:
The Passau Wolf is one of the most famous historical symbols of the city of St. Pölten and commemorates the city's centuries-long affiliation with the Diocese of Passau. The wolf sculpture visible today was erected between 1937 and 1938 and placed on Kardinal-Franz-König-Platz. It is part of a fountain and stands on a stele together with the city coat of arms, emphasizing its heraldic significance. The figure was created by Austrian sculptor Ferdinand Andri, while the architectural design of the fountain was created by architect Rudolf Wondracek.

The wolf is not there as a decorative animal motif, but as a deliberately chosen symbol of power and identity. The so-called Passau wolf is an ancient heraldic figure that originally comes from the coat of arms of the city and the bishopric of Passau and can be traced back to the Middle Ages. Since St. Pölten was under the secular and spiritual rule of the bishops of Passau for many centuries, this symbol was also incorporated into the city's coat of arms.

The Alaska Brown Bear diorama in the Bernard Family Hall of North American Mammals depicts two brown bears that have gathered at a stream near Canoe Bay, Alaska. Belmore Browne (with George Browne) painted the background scene featuring the Aghileen Pinnacles appearing as snow-covered volcanic mountains behind the bears. The foreground artist was G. Frederick Mason (with Joseph Guerry). Robert Rockwell constructed the iconic taxidermy bears. Originally completed in 1941, the diorama was restored during the hall’s restoration in 2011-2012.

The exhibition hall opened in 1942 as the new Hall of North American Mammals. Ten dioramas were completed initially; work on the hall halted during World War II; final completion 1954. All exhibition work completed under the direction of James L. Clark and Albert E. Butler.

name: Porcine/Wild Boar Mandible
description:
High-resolution 3D anatomical scan of a Porcine / Wild Boar Mandible (Sus scrofa).

This digital model delivers a  representation of the lower jaw osteology in suids. The mandible showcases a robust, elongated horizontal ramus (corpus mandibulae) fused at the mental symphysis, built to withstand the heavy mechanical stress of rooting and crushing food. The scan highlights the specialized omnivorous dentition, featuring strong incisors, highly developed canine teeth (tusks, which are continuously growing and self-sharpening in wild specimens/males), and broad bunodont molars adapted for grinding varied organic matter.

Source / Provenance: This specimen is part of the anatomical collection curated by Professor Antonio Palladino, Professor of Veterinary Anatomy, Histology, and Embryology at the University of Rome Tor Vergata.

Suggested Use: Educational purposes, veterinary research, comparative anatomy study, and scientific visualization.

name: Animated Amargasaurus
description:
If you to travel back to Argentina some 130 million years ago, you might spot an Amargasaurus. It was a sauropod but not one of these enormous giants most of us had come to know. It was about 30 to 33 feet long and weighed only about 2 to 3 tons, lighter than a big Brachiosaurus by far.What made this dinosaur stand out was its appearance. It had two rows of tall, sharp spines that ran across its neck and back. This is the only dinosaur known to have spikes like that. The scientists aren't sure exactly what those spikes were used for. Perhaps they would say that these are for showing off, for defense, or to help with body heat.Like its relatives, it was an herbivore. It spent its days eating plants, using its long neck to grab leaves and low vegetation.

Badtz-maru, バッドばつ丸, the mischievous little penguin with spiky hair. He is one of the many characters produced by the Japanese company Sanrio and created by Hisato Inoue in 1993. Badtz-maru attracts lots of attention as he walks his pet alligator, Pochi. Badtz-maru has dreams of greatness when he grows up, but for now he rolls his eyes at his humorous life in Gorgeoustown.

Hana-Maru, グッドはな丸, a white seal born at Kokuritsu Hospital, London. He can do ball acrobatics and likes gardening. In Japanese, he is called Good Hana-Maru, in contrast to Bad Badtz-Maru. A 'hanamaru' is a swirly and elaborate circle-mark, signifying not just a correct answer but a very good one. 
He's a very good-natured seal who can be friends with anybody!

Despite how conflicting he and Badtz-Maru are personality-wise, they are the best of friends.

name: Иксодовый клещ
description:
Коллеги, предлагаю углубиться в детальную характеристику иксодовых клещей (Ixodidae) — не просто кровососов, а высокоспециализированных организмов, играющих ключевую роль в эпидемиологии многих природно-очаговых заболеваний.

Морфологически это существа с уникальными адаптациями. Их тело представляет собой единый идиосому, а ротовой аппарат (гнатосома) — это сложный режуще-сосущий инструмент. Хелицеры, снабженные зубцами, разрезают кожу, а гипостом, покрытый направленными назад зубчиками, как якорь, прочно фиксирует клеща в коже хозяина. Примечательно, что слюна клеща — это не просто антикоагулянт. Это многокомпонентный коктейль, содержащий анестезирующие, противовоспалительные и иммуносупрессивные вещества, которые обеспечивают незаметность прикрепления и длительное беспрепятственное питание. Именно слюна является главным проводником патогенов

name: Fossil brown bear (atlas)
description:
3D scan of the atlas of a  fossil brown bear (*Ursus arctos*). 


Fossil of a prime adult female skull of brown bear. The specimen was found in "Abisso Oriano Coltelli" cave (44°05'35,0 N, 10°14'47,0" E, labelled T/Lu 642 in the Tuscan register of caves) which opens at 1209 m a.s.l on the western slope of "Monte Alto di Sella" (Apuan Alps). The mammal assemblage collected consists of 486 investigated specimens, 127 of which belong to an individual skeleton of brown bear. The bear died from non-violent causes, probably during hibernation. The specimen was dated providing a conventional age of 6480 ± 40 14 C ka BP (Holocene).
More information : https://amq.aiqua.it/index.php/amq/article/view/112



Specimen: Brown bear, *Ursus arctos* Linnaeus, 1758

name: Brachiospinus Altus - dinosaur
description:
**"Brachiospinus Altus: The River Giant of the Mid-Cretaceous"**

First documented in the Kem Kem beds of North Africa, *Brachiospinus altus* was a towering semi-aquatic herbivore that roamed floodplains 100 million years ago. This rare hybrid species combined the elongated neck and forelimb-dominant stance of *Brachiosaurus* with the iconic sail of *Spinosaurus aegyptiacus*. Standing over 50 feet long, its sail likely served for thermoregulation and display, while its powerful limbs allowed it to wade through shallow waters in search of vegetation. Fossilized impressions reveal a mottled skin pattern of ochre, green, and rust, ideal for camouflage among reeds and riverbanks. Though peaceful in nature, its sheer size and tail strength made it a formidable presence. *Brachiospinus* reshapes our understanding of sauropod adaptation in aquatic ecosystems.

Прісноводний скат – Potamotrygon motoro мешкає у річках Південної Америки, зокрема в басейнах Амазонки, Оріноко та Ла-Плати. Це один із небагатьох скатів, які адаптувалися до життя у прісній воді.
Отруйний хвіст – на його хвості є шипи, покриті токсичною слизом. Укуси можуть бути дуже болючими для людини та викликати серйозні запалення.
Яскраве забарвлення – цей скат має округле тіло з характерними помаранчевими плямами, що робить його популярним серед акваріумістів.
Живородний вид – самка не відкладає ікру, а народжує повністю сформованих маленьких скатів, які одразу можуть самостійно плавати та шукати їжу.
Розумні та соціальні – вони здатні впізнавати господаря, взаємодіяти з ним і навіть навчатися простим командам, якщо їх утримувати в неволі.

name: Bulldog Ant - insect
description:
The bulldog ant (Mymecia pyriformis) is one of the most dangerous species of ants in the world, native to Australia. Known for aggressive nature and potent venom, the bulldog ant is capable of inflicting severe pain with its sting. These ants are characterized by their large, reddish-brown bodies and muscular mandibles, which they use for both defense and hunting.
Bulldog ants are known to actively hunt for prey, including insects, small vertebrates, and even humans if provoked. Their venom contains toxins that can cause intense pain, swelling, and allergic reactions in humans, with some species’ stings being fatal if not treated. They are also highly territorial and will aggressively defend their nests.
Despite their fearsome reputation, bulldog ants play an important role in their ecosystem as both predators and scavengers. They are typically found in forests, woodlands, and other habitats with dense vegetation. Their speed, agility, and venomous defense mechanisms make them a significant force in the wild

Tham khảo thêm các thông tin tại:
👉👉👉: https://www.bitchute.com/channel/p5G36Kscijw3/
👉👉👉: https://band.us/band/94374549
👉👉👉: https://ko-fi.com/vinhomescoloahn

Cầu Tứ Liên là một cây cầu dây văng hiện đại bắc qua sông Hồng, nối liền quận Tây Hồ và huyện Đông Anh, Hà Nội. Cầu có tổng chiều dài 2,924 km, gồm cầu chính dài 1 km, rộng 33 m với 6 làn xe cơ giới, 2 làn hỗn hợp và 2 làn đi bộ. Cầu Tứ Liên được khởi công xây dựng vào năm 2021 và dự kiến hoàn thành vào năm 2025.

Cầu Tứ Liên được thiết kế với kiến trúc hiện đại, kết hợp giữa văng xoắn và văng harp, tạo nên một biểu tượng mới cho thủ đô Hà Nội. Cầu có hai trụ tháp chính cao 110 m, được thiết kế mô phỏng hình ảnh cánh diều, thể hiện cho sự bay cao, vươn xa của Việt Nam.

Cầu Tứ Liên khi hoàn thành sẽ góp phần giải quyết tình trạng tắc nghẽn giao thông trên các tuyến đường hiện hữu như Võ Chí Công, Phạm Văn Đồng, Thăng Long,... đồng thời thúc đẩy phát triển kinh tế - xã hội khu vực phía Bắc Hà Nội.

Os Thalassinoides são icnofósseis, representados por redes complexas de galerias, túneis e marcas deixadas por organismos em ambientes marinhos e proximo-marinhos. Frequentemente criados por crustáceos decápodes do grupo Thalassinidea, também podem ser originados por vermes poliquetas, insetos e peixes como raias e pleuronectiformes, que criam estruturas similares em ambientes costeiros.

(ENG)
Thalassinoids are ichnofossils with shapes such as galleries and tunnels primarily in marine sedimentary environments, often made by Thalassinidea decapod crustaceans. Other creators include true shrimps, prawns, lobsters, mud shrimps, polychaete worms known for branching burrows, insect larvae like beetles in coastal areas, and fish such as rays and pleuronectiforms (e.g., plaice) that exhibit similar behaviors.

description:
This 3D model presents a detailed depiction of a **monkey infected with the Monkeypox virus**, offering a realistic and educational visualization. The monkey is shown with visible symptoms of the virus, such as ** pox lesions on the skin, particularly around the face, arms, and body** . The model is carefully crafted to reflect the physical appearance of a primate, with lifelike fur texture, expressive eyes, and anatomical accuracy.

The lesions are rendered with attention to detail, highlighting the swollen and blistered appearance typical of the infection. This model is ideal for use in medical animations, educational content, or any project focused on virology, public health, or wildlife. It serves as a powerful tool for raising awareness and understanding of the effects of the Monkeypox virus on primates.
